description: Shared Budget: ask before each purchase. ALLOW records it against the team cap (returns spend_id + what's left); DENY or ESCALATE records nothing, with the reason. Idempotent by idempotency_key, so retries never double-count. Header X-Budget-Key. Honest limit: two spends in the same instant can both pass; per_tx_max_usd bounds that. By OMENZ. (MCP calls run in AYNE, the free playzone; production: POST https://www.omenz.org/api/tollbooth/v1/budget/spend, $0.002 via x402.)
